boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Central Florida, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe campus loop that moves from orientation landmarks to outdoor space, recreation, art, and a practical study stop.

cards.title: Start at the Reflecting Pond
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · central campus landmark
cards.notes: Begin near Millican Hall, take a lap around the pond, and use the open edge to orient yourself before choosing the next stop.
cards.short_summary: A central landmark for starting a self-guided campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF’s self-guided tour begins in front of Millican Hall at the Reflecting Pond, and UCF describes it as a marquee informal gathering location.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus location; follow posted campus and event-use rules.

cards.title: Use the Student Union as your waypoint
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Heart of Campus
cards.notes: Step inside to locate student resources and dining options, then exit toward the Boardwalk for a scenic route to nearby campus stops.
cards.short_summary: A central hub for resources, activities, student spaces, and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF identifies the Student Union as the Heart of Campus and a hub for student resources, activities, student spaces, and dining options.
cards.access_notes: Indoor services and dining availability can vary; check the Union before making plans.

cards.title: Walk the John T. Washington Center breezeway
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · beside the Student Union
cards.notes: Follow the breezeway beside the library and Union, pausing to view the John T. Washington mural and identify services you may use later.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gathering place with services along the breezeway.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says the John T. Washington Center is adjacent to the library and Student Union and features a mural honoring Washington’s campus contributions.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor breezeway; individual businesses and services set their own availability.

cards.title: Pause on Memory Mall
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · between the Union and Addition Financial Arena
cards.notes: Cross the large lawn at an easy pace and note the paths toward Knights Plaza and the arena, saving event plans for another day.
cards.short_summary: An expansive campus lawn between the Student Union and Addition Financial Arena.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF describes Memory Mall as the large grass area between the Student Union and Addition Financial Arena.
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; scheduled events and reservations may affect use.

cards.title: See what is on view at UCF Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Visual Arts Building
cards.notes: Visit the gallery during weekday public hours, take in the current exhibition, and use the Visual Arts Building as a new campus reference point.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus gallery visit with rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCF Art Gallery is in the Visual Arts Building on main campus, is open Monday–Friday from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., and has free admission.
cards.source_title: About the Gallery — UCF Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed on major holidays. Complimentary parking is available in Garage F.

cards.title: Take a daylight Arboretum walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · 4312 Scorpius St.
cards.notes: Choose a self-guided path through the natural areas or campus landscapes, bring water, and finish before sunset rather than rushing the loop.
cards.short_summary: A public, no-admission nature stop for a self-guided walk.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Arboretum natural areas and trails are open to the public from sunrise to sunset every day, with no admission charge.
cards.access_notes: Open sunrise to sunset daily; trails are not currently wheelchair accessible, though an all-terrain wheelchair is available on request.

cards.entity_name: William E. and Mary Jo Davis Recreation Area at Lake Claire
cards.title: Get outside at Lake Claire
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Lake Claire Recreation Area
cards.notes: Visit the recreation area with friends, check the Outdoor Adventure desk for current equipment options, and follow all posted water-safety policies.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation area with outdoor facilities and water-vessel checkouts.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says Lake Claire offers students equipment and water-vessel checkouts through its Outdoor Adventure program.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Adventure — UCF Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.access_notes: Swimming, alcohol, tobacco, fishing, and motorized boats are prohibited; equipment rentals require a waiver and may have fees.

cards.title: Tour the Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · recreation and fitness stop
cards.notes: Stop by to learn the layout, then plan a future workout or climbing session after confirming your student eligibility and current facility access.
cards.short_summary: A large recreation facility with fitness, aquatics, courts, and climbing.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF’s campus tour identifies the Recreation and Wellness Center as a 150,000-square-foot facility with pools, fitness areas, a climbing tower, and courts.
cards.access_notes: Facility use is subject to current Recreation and Wellness Center eligibility, policies, and operating hours.

cards.title: Plan a future Challenge Course session
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · near the Barbara Ying Center
cards.notes: If you have a group to bring together, review the low-element options and reservation process instead of arriving expecting a walk-in activity.
cards.short_summary: A reservation-based adventure-learning program for team building.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF states that its Challenge Course supports team building, self-confidence, and leadership through adventure-based learning and is open by reservation or special event only.
cards.source_title: Challenge Course — UCF Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.access_notes: Reservation or special event required; program prices vary. Wear required athletic attire and closed-toe shoes when participating.

cards.title: End with a library reset
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · next to the Reflecting Pond
cards.notes: Pick a study setting, locate the research-help desk, and make a short list of services you can return to when coursework begins.
cards.short_summary: A central study and research hub with varied workspaces and support.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF identifies the John C. Hitt Library as its main library, with open study areas, group rooms, computer labs, research help, and tutoring and writing support.
cards.source_title: John C. Hitt Library — UCF Location
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours and access rules before visiting; visitor parking may require a permit or meter payment.
